name: loom-workspace
description: Loom-managed workspace with AI development orchestration

scripts.check:ci: npm run lint && npm run test && npm run check:reuse
scripts.test: python3 -m pytest verification/model verification/test_check_pins.py verification/test_check_reuse.py verification/test_record_lib.py
scripts.lint: python3 -m compileall -q verification flow && git ls-files -z '*.sh' ':!.loom' ':!.claude' ':!.agents' ':!loom.sh' | xargs -0 -n1 bash -n && python3 verification/check_pins.py
